From adbe6991efd36104ac9eaf751993d35eaa7f493a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Bjorn Helgaas <bhelgaas@google.com>
Date: Wed, 29 May 2013 16:29:55 -0600
Subject: [PATCH] bio-integrity: Fix use of bs->bio_integrity_pool after free

This fixes a copy and paste error introduced by 9f060e2231
("block: Convert integrity to bvec_alloc_bs()").

Found by Coverity (CID 1020654).

Signed-off-by: Bjorn Helgaas <bhelgaas@google.com>
Acked-by: Kent Overstreet <koverstreet@google.com>
Signed-off-by: Jens Axboe <axboe@kernel.dk>

diff --git a/fs/bio-integrity.c b/fs/bio-integrity.c
index 8fb42916d8a2..45e944fe52a6 100644
--- a/fs/bio-integrity.c
+++ b/fs/bio-integrity.c
@@ -734,7 +734,7 @@ void bioset_integrity_free(struct bio_set *bs)
 		mempool_destroy(bs->bio_integrity_pool);
 
 	if (bs->bvec_integrity_pool)
-		mempool_destroy(bs->bio_integrity_pool);
+		mempool_destroy(bs->bvec_integrity_pool);
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL(bioset_integrity_free);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `fs/bio-integrity.c`**
   - The line that previously destroyed the `bio_integrity_pool` when `bvec_integrity_pool` was not NULL has been modified. 
   - The erroneous line:
     ```c
     mempool_destroy(bs->bio_integrity_pool);
     ```
     has been replaced with:
     ```c
     mempool_destroy(bs->bvec_integrity_pool);
     ```
   - This change corrects a copy-paste error that was introduced in a previous commit.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `fs/bio-integrity.c` addresses a bug related to the improper use of the `bio_integrity_pool` after it has been freed. The fix ensures that the correct memory pool (`bvec_integrity_pool`) is destroyed instead of the already freed `bio_integrity_pool`, thus preventing potential use-after-free errors. This change is a direct response to a bug identified by Coverity, indicating that the previous implementation could lead to undefined behavior or crashes.

Here is the commit message:
bio-integrity: Fix use of bs->bio_integrity_pool after free

This fixes a copy and paste error introduced by 9f060e2231
("block: Convert integrity to bvec_alloc_bs()").

Found by Coverity (CID 1020654).

Signed-off-by: Bjorn Helgaas <bhelgaas@google.com>
Acked-by: Kent Overstreet <koverstreet@google.com>
Signed-off-by: Jens Axboe <axboe@kernel.dk>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by a copy-and-paste error where the code incorrectly attempted to destroy the `bio_integrity_pool` instead of the `bvec_integrity_pool`. This mistake occurred during the implementation of a previous change, leading to the potential use of a freed memory pool, which could result in undefined behavior or crashes.

Here is the patch:
 
 void bioset_integrity_free(struct bio_set *bs)
 {
 	if (bs->bio_integrity_pool)
 		mempool_destroy(bs->bio_integrity_pool);
 
 	if (bs->bvec_integrity_pool)
-		mempool_destroy(bs->bio_integrity_pool);
+		mempool_destroy(bs->bvec_integrity_pool);
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL(bioset_integrity_free);
